payload.name: WSI-induced cognitive load reduction
payload.fact: Whole slide imaging (WSI) instruction significantly reduces intrinsic and extraneous cognitive load compared to conventional microphotograph-based methods.

provenance.title: Whole slide imaging in medical education: A comparative study of learning experience and engagement using cognitive diagnostic modeling
provenance.quote_or_locus: WSI sessions significantly reduced intrinsic and extraneous cognitive load, supporting more efficient learning

decision_note: REJECT, NOT_TRANSFERABLE, delegated by owner. A real display-format comparison, but between whole-slide imaging and photomicrographs for trainees reading pathology slides. The variable is a specialist imaging modality and the population is medical, so the finding cannot be restated as something a product surface can change.
